name: cpu_freq_table
desc: 列出各CPU可用governor与频率档位
cmd: c=/sys/devices/system/cpu/${cpu:-cpu0}/cpufreq; echo '-- governors --'; cat $c/scaling_available_governors 2>/dev/null; echo '-- freqs(kHz) --'; cat $c/scaling_available_frequencies 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '-- max/min --'; cat $c/cpuinfo_max_freq 2>/dev/null; cat $c/cpuinfo_min_freq 2>/dev/null
